text: I LOVE how all pets, quests, hatching potions, food, armors, literally everything other than basic to do lists are locked behind a paywall. You need gems for everything and not even completing challanges from the habitica team ensures you can get them back. You can't do any fun feature unless you pay, not even if you put in effort
author: Theo Chiș
developer_reply: Hi there, Theo! We're sorry to hear that Habitica hasn't been the right fit for you. We encourage you to complete your tasks and dailies to earn random pet eggs and food. And the many items in the Enchanted Armoire are available with coins you earn from completing your tasks, not from gems.
